# Mary Stubbs

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v5 c5 P38](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0038)</sub>
- **Origin:** Seven Gulls  <sub>[v5 c8 P51](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0051), [v5 c18 P9](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** knitter  <sub>[v5 c15 P0](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Mary Martha Lucilla Vane Ball Stubbs  <sub>[v5 c5 P57](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0057)</sub>; Mary-creature  <sub>[v5 c8 P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mary has a full face with rosy cheeks, crimped hair, and peculiar, luminous, pale eyes. She possesses long, pliable fingers that she uses to make extraordinary shadow art on walls. After moving in with Winifred Kerr, she wears a fresh blue velvet cap adorned with a scarlet rosette, a navy blue cloth coat, and a squirrel fur muff with red satin lining and red tassels.

_Sources: [v5 c6 P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031), [v5 c7 P11](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0011), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005)_

## Personality

Mary is proud, hardworking, and savagely blunt, yet she can also be merry and captivating to her companions. She is obsessively clean, cunning, and clever, though she can also be boastful, unwise, and given to sharing frightening ghost stories. Although she is not excessively thin-skinned and does not harbor long feuds, she is quick to defend her friends and fiercely stands by them.

_Sources: [v5 c6 P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030), [v5 c6 P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031), [v5 c9 P26](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0026), [v5 c12 P36](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0036), [v5 c18 P5](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0005), [v5 c18 P13](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0013), [v5 c23 P4](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0004), [v5 c23 P40](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0040), [v5 c34 P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)_

## History

Mary grew up as a homeless orphan after her parents squandered her wealthy grandfather's fortune. She spent two years residing at an asylum before being taken in by Mrs. Grimble, an abusive taskmaster who overworked, underfed, and beat her. After running away, Mary was discovered by the Ashdowns freezing and starving in James Taylor's barn. She spent time with the local children at Fern Hollow, quickly establishing herself as a lively, captivating companion who taught them tricks, played the jew's-harp, and told spine-tingling ghost stories. During a confrontation over fish, she famously chased Tessa Carrow with an enormous dried codfish. Miss Winifred Kerr took Mary into her home, where Mary worked indefatigably as a domestic helper and knitter while learning to act respectably. Though lectured by Miss Winifred after scaring the younger children with ghost tales and stepmother stories, Mary remained fiercely loyal to her new home and her companions at Fern Hollow.

_Sources: [v5 c5 P35](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0035), [v5 c5 P57](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0057), [v5 c5 P108](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0108), [v5 c6 P30](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0030), [v5 c6 P31](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0031), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c8 P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004), [v5 c12 P36](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0036), [v5 c15 P0](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0000), [v5 c18 P13](../source/v05-c18.md#nw-v05-c18-p0013), [v5 c23 P84](../source/v05-c23.md#nw-v05-c23-p0084), [v5 c26 P26](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0026), [v5 c31 P32](../source/v05-c31.md#nw-v05-c31-p0032)_
